name: Zahra
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c136573]Zaton[/url] is her husband.

My rose of the desert. She has been my faithful partner for more than two decades now. Fierce, loving, wise beyond her yeas and intelligent, I could not ask for a better companion to lead this House with. She knows me better than myself, knows how to calm the storm in my mind, and the temper in my heart.

Her body is still that of the young woman I took for a wife, and she responds to my touch as the first time I laid my fingers on her. Never jealous, but fiercely protective of her dignity and her standing, she truly is my counterpart in more ways than I can count.
